_readme: Phase 1 — Source catalogue. We list candidate OPEN sources BEFORE fetching anything. trust_level: high=official/govt, medium=major news/big directory, low=small blog. access_method: how we would read it. update_frequency: how often it changes. respect_robots: we honour robots.txt and only automate sources that permit it. Each source has an id referenced by dataset records in source_links[].

government_open_data.name: data.gov.in — Open Government Data (Vadodara datasets)
government_open_data.notes: CANDIDATE. India's official open-data portal has a documented JSON API (free API key). Best legitimate source for registries/statistics. Enable by adding an API key + dataset ids to halo_config.

government_open_data.name: Gujarat State Open Data Portal
government_open_data.notes: CANDIDATE. State datasets/notifications. Verify robots/terms before crawling.

government_open_data.name: Vadodara Municipal Corporation (VMC) portal
government_open_data.notes: CANDIDATE. Zones/wards, tenders, notices, some property-tax/tenement search. LEGAL NOTE: use only pages that VMC's robots.txt/terms permit automated access to; property-tax/citizen-login areas are personal-data and NOT to be scraped. Public reference pages only.

government_open_data.name: Gujarat Tourism — official attractions (Vadodara & nearby)
government_open_data.notes: CANDIDATE. Feeds the TRIP_SPOT entity (temples, palaces, dams, hills within 10-50 km). Robots-respecting HTML.

history_knowledge.name: English Wikipedia (MediaWiki API)
history_knowledge.notes: Open JSON API, no key. Plain-text extracts of Vadodara/Gaekwad/Baroda pages -> HISTORY docs (CC-BY-SA, attribution kept via source link).

history_knowledge.name: Gujarati Wikipedia (MediaWiki API)
history_knowledge.notes: Gujarati text; machine-translated gu->en (LibreTranslate/Argos) with the original kept verbatim for review (needs_translation flag if no engine).

history_knowledge.name: Archive.org — public-domain books (Vadodara/Baroda)
history_knowledge.notes: Open API. Book title/year/language/description with a details link. Full-text OCR + translation is a future step.

history_knowledge.name: Wikisource (Gujarati/English source texts)
history_knowledge.notes: CANDIDATE. Digitised primary texts; same translate pipeline.

internal.name: Halo curated seed — hand-entered real place names, pending source attribution
internal.notes: NOT a verification. A real Vadodara place name entered by hand from general/open knowledge. Records carrying only this source stay status=single_source_needs_review until a live extractor corroborates them against a catalogued directory/census source.

areas_wards_villages.name: Census 2011 — Vadodara city / district ward & population tables
areas_wards_villages.notes: Ward-level names + population. Static (2011) but authoritative baseline.

areas_wards_villages.name: Vadodara Municipal Corporation (VMC) — zones & wards
areas_wards_villages.notes: Official zone/ward structure. Post-2021 reconstitution: 4 zones, 19 wards. Confirm current count at time of use.

areas_wards_villages.name: VUDA — Development Plan village/locality maps
areas_wards_villages.notes: Named villages/localities inside the urban development authority boundary.

areas_wards_villages.name: LocalBodyData — VMC ward numbers + LGD codes
areas_wards_villages.notes: Cross-reference ward numbers and Local Government Directory (LGD) codes.

areas_wards_villages.name: India Post — PIN code directory (Vadodara)
areas_wards_villages.notes: Authoritative PIN codes per locality/post office.

areas_wards_villages.name: OpenStreetMap — place nodes (suburbs/neighbourhoods/villages)
areas_wards_villages.notes: Grows the AREA list beyond the curated seed with real OSM place=* nodes (name + coordinates).

areas_wards_villages.name: OpenStreetMap — Nominatim geocoder (locality -> lat/lon)
areas_wards_villages.notes: Geocodes AREA localities to coordinates for near-me search (ODbL). Self-host for bulk runs. In the sandbox, coordinates come from a labelled demo fixture instead.

areas_wards_villages.name: Census 2011 — Vadodara district/taluka village directory
areas_wards_villages.notes: CANDIDATE (not yet fetched). Official village list per taluka — the promotion path to status=confirmed_official for villages.

areas_wards_villages.name: MapsofIndia — Vadodara taluka/district village list
areas_wards_villages.notes: CANDIDATE. Village names per taluka; corroborates census.

areas_wards_villages.name: PropTiger / Housing — Vadodara localities
areas_wards_villages.notes: CANDIDATE. Second independent locality list for multi_source promotion.

areas_wards_villages.name: "Complete List of Areas in Vadodara" directory pages
areas_wards_villages.notes: CANDIDATE. Low trust — corroborate with a higher-trust source before promotion.

services.name: Justdial — Vadodara category listings
services.notes: Large directory. HEAVY anti-bot + robots restrictions — only use where permitted; treat phone numbers as leads (no auto-publish).

services.name: Sulekha — Vadodara services
services.notes: Services/professionals. Same consent rule: numbers are leads, not public contacts.

services.name: OpenStreetMap — Overpass API (shops/amenities in Vadodara)
services.notes: OPEN, license-friendly (ODbL, attribution required). Best first source for names + coordinates + category. Rarely has ratings.

services.name: Chamber-of-commerce / trade-body member PDFs
services.notes: Member firm lists as structured PDF tables.

news_events.name: Times of India — Vadodara city section
news_events.notes: Prefer RSS where available (cheapest, cleanest). Major-source corroboration for event 'confirmed' status.

news_events.name: Indian Express — Gujarat / Vadodara
news_events.notes: Second independent major source for cross-validation.

news_events.name: Gujarat Samachar — Vadodara (Gujarati)
news_events.notes: Gujarati-language coverage; useful for hyperlocal events national press misses.

travel_nearby.name: Gujarat Tourism — official portal
travel_nearby.notes: Official descriptions + how-to-reach for regional spots.

travel_nearby.name: Vadodara District — tourism / places of interest
travel_nearby.notes: Government district page; authoritative for nearby attractions.

travel_nearby.name: Travel blogs / guides (Vadodara & nearby)
travel_nearby.notes: Mood/vibe descriptions. Low trust — must be corroborated by >=1 higher-trust source before a trip_spot is accepted.
